Four ways I use AI to make money There are four different places AI skills can create value. The right starting point depends on the work you already understand. 1. Inside your job. Build a knowledge base from information you are allowed to use, connect relevant tools, and document repeatable procedures. Useful reports and clearer answers make the value visible to your team. 2. Consulting. Map how work actually moves before choosing a tool. Find the bottleneck, then fix it with automation, AI, or a simpler process. The finished improvement is what a client pays for. 3. Production services. Package a finished image, video, or other creative deliverable around the client's need. Price the complete work, including your judgment, revisions, and delivery. 4. Your own product. Build a useful tool, course, template, or digital resource that more than one customer can buy. It takes work to create, market, support, and improve it, but you can reuse the product rather than starting each delivery from scratch. If you already have a job, start with a useful internal task.
